measurements.origin: (Pragmático Aroma Lda, Alfândega da Fé, Bragança, Portugal
measurements.equipment: HPLC chromatograph (Hewlett-Packard 1100, Agilent Technologies, Santa Clara, CA, US) with a double online detection using a diode array detector (DAD) with 280, 330 and 370 nm as preference wavelengths, and a mass spectrometer (MS) equipped with an ESI source and a triple quadrupole-ion trap mass analyser, which was connected to the HPLC system via the DAD cell outlet
measurements.citation: Pereira et al., 2016. LWT - Food Science and Technology, 71, 370-377.
